requirement.description: Simulator class initialization issues causing 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'tick/set/posedge/changed/delay/get' errors. Multiple test cases fail due to improper initialization of simulation objects before method calls, affecting 10+ test cases.
requirement.contract: Ensure Simulator instances properly initialize internal simulation state before any method calls. All methods like tick(), set(), posedge(), changed(), delay(), get() must be callable after simulator construction without raising AttributeError.

requirement.description: Missing BrokenTrigger class definition causing NameError in simulator regression tests. The class is referenced but not defined in the codebase, affecting 2 test cases.
requirement.contract: Define the BrokenTrigger class that is expected to be raised by certain simulator operations. This class should be accessible in the simulator module namespace.

requirement.description: Domain lookup failure causing KeyError when accessing 'Domain 'a' not found in fragment hierarchy'. The fragment hierarchy management lacks proper domain lookup mechanisms, affecting 1 test case.
requirement.contract: Implement proper domain lookup functionality in the HDL IR module to resolve domains by name within fragment hierarchies. Ensure all domain references can be resolved correctly.
